speaker: 真島
sentence: アカン、俺は何を普通に話し込んでるんや……！
literal: Damn it, what am I doing just sitting here chatting away like normal...!
official_candidate: Me? I'm super into skiing lately. I'm on the slopes just about every weekend!
official_neighbors: (What the shit is THAT!? Dude is like a lust machine! Is Odyssey popular with that crowd? Is there even a crowd for... whatever that is?)
Hi there!
(Figures they wouldn't waste Nozomi on a first-timer. Still, I can probably pump good intel outta this gal.)
Whoa, they sent me a ten and a half!
Aww, thanks! Now, what can we get you to drink?
Hm, why don't we kick things off with champagne?
You got it! Drink order, please!
(Okay, what's my plan of attack here? What do I ask to get info on Nozomi?)
So, got any hobbies, Takako-chan?
Me? I'm super into skiing lately. I'm on the slopes just about every weekend!
I got my eye on this new snow suit that's MEGA cute! Now I just need someone to come along and buy it for me, ha ha...
Plannin' to get one of your customers to buy it for ya?
Aw, none of my regulars are that sweet... Which means this is the perfect chance for somebody new to make their move!
Sure sounds like it. If you're a good girl, maybe Santa will bring it for ya. You got a stocking big enough to hold it?
Heyyy, don't be mean! And whatever, I'll just buy it for myself, so nyah!
(Ugh, why am I chattin' this girl up like a tool? Damn near forgot why I came in.)
Awful busy in here tonight. Is business always this brisk?
Well, the holiday season certainly helps, but they also told us girls we've all gotta bring a guy in with us every night, so maybe that's helping too?
Oh, yeah? Huh... Gotta say, this place don't look like it's so hard-up that they've gotta force the hostesses to bring dates in.
Oh, that's just their pride talkin'.
